title: IPC admin.trust.set params
description: Allow one peer on the data plane, or revoke it (2.1). `allowed: true` adds it, refused `InvalidArgument` for this profile's own identity or for a new peer once the allowlist holds 4096; `allowed: false` removes it, closes every connection it holds at once, drops its cached endpoint directory, and every connection with `events` sees `peer.disconnected` with `reason_class: policy` (ADR-0012). Adding a listed peer and removing an unlisted one are no-ops answered `ok`. A RUNTIME OVERLAY, lost on restart, never written to config.yaml (ADR-0028); every set is written to the daemon's log.
